messages:
Annie (PM): quick thought — when folks save a per-route or per-model view, show an estimated token burn and latency breakdown per pinned model variant. helps teams pick defaults and avoid surprise quota hits :money_with_wings:
Dmitri (Eng): +1. We should also surface cache/KV reuse at the route level so people can see how much prefix/KV caching will reduce cost for that view.
Sam (Console): UX idea: small "cost preview" chip next to Save that expands into a per-model breakdown. Lightweight by default, expandable for details.
Maria (SRE): caution: exposing per-route cache stats could increase telemetry volume. We need sampling or pre-aggregation.
Dmitri (Eng): API proposal: extend saved-views endpoint with optional fields: `route_hint`, `quota_preview` (bool), `telemetry_sample_rate`. Backend computes an estimate when requested.
Annie (PM): can you paste a minimal example payload?
Dmitri (Eng): ```json
POST /v1/saved_views
{ "filters": {"path": "/checkout"}, "route_hint": "checkout", "quota_preview": true }
```
Sam (Console): compatibility note — default `quota_preview=false`. UI shows preview only if the flag is on and org has opted into the feature.
Maria (SRE): for sampling: recommend default sample_rate = 0.01 for per-route per-model counters. If an org toggles quota_preview we can temporarily bump sampling for their view calculation and then decay.
Annie (PM): rollout plan: canary to 10% orgs, opt-in toggle in Console, track regressions via our eval prompts and metric diffs.
Sam (Console): front-end contract: new endpoint `/api/preview/cost` returning an array: [{model, est_tokens, est_latency_ms, cache_hit_rate}]. Keep payload small (max 10 models).
Dmitri (Eng): debate — compute preview on save (fast UI, maybe stale) vs compute on load (accurate, heavy). Thoughts?
Maria (SRE): compromise: compute-on-save, store timestamp + preview vector, run background refreshes. Mark preview stale after 24h and show "refresh" CTA.
Annie (PM): +1. Also add a tooltip explaining estimation window and sampling caveats so customers understand variance.
Sam (Console): I'll mock the UI and the `preview/cost` response shape, then open a PR. Backend ticket to add the optional fields and a background refresher.
Dmitri (Eng): backend: we'll need a worker that can recompute estimates async and a rate-limiter per-org to avoid spikes. Also decide whether to persist sample traces for replay.
Maria (SRE): rate-limiter SGTM. Persisting traces might be heavy — prefer aggregated counters with short TTL unless debugging mode is on.
rollout-bot: Canary rollout started for quota-preview v1 -> 10% orgs :rocket:
Annie (PM): thanks — please drop PR links here when ready and tag infra for rate-limiter review. :eyes:
